messages:
maria: Heads-up: opened a docs PR for the Private/VPC migration guide (https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/523). Need: a concise preflight conn-check section (python + rust examples), a tiny curl example for the installer preflight, and a revised network diagram that calls out dual-homed HSMs and MTU pitfalls.

jon: I can update the diagram. Do you want the SVG to include redundant SNI proxy and a note about jumbo frames / PMTU?

samira: Yes on redundant SNI proxy. Please annotate the path that should never have public egress (HSM subnets) and add a small callout: "Watch PMTU & TCP MSS; tunneling may reduce effective MTU."

kevin: I'll add the code snippets. Quick question: show the full KMS short-lived token exchange or keep examples to the client-side conn-check only?

maria: Keep snippets minimal — just the client-side conn-check using a short-lived token. Add a single-line comment that links to the PKCS#11 appendix for air-gapped setups. Ops prefers short examples they can paste.

kevin: Added Python snippet to the PR description (three lines):

```py
# python conn-check using short-lived KMS token
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.environ['RW_KMS_TOKEN'])
print(c.status.check('private-hsm'))  # token ~60s
```

kevin: And a minimal Rust example (using hypothetical sdk crate) for platform folks: 

```rust
// rust conn-check example
let client = redwood_sdk::Client::from_env();
match client.status().check("private-hsm") {
    Ok(s) => println!("ok: {:?}", s),
    Err(e) => eprintln!("conn-check failed: {}", e),
}
```

kevin: Also added tiny curl for installer preflight to the PR: 

```bash
# installer preflight to local conn-checker
curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KMS_TOKEN" \
  https://127.0.0.1:8443/preflight | jq -r '.summary'
```

jon: Uploaded updated diagram to docs/assets/private-migration-v2.svg and referenced it from the guide. Diagram includes primary VPC peering, HA HSM cluster in private subnet, NATed bastion path, and a fallback SNI proxy path.

link-bot: Linkcheck: 1 failed anchor -> offline-install#verify-checksum. Recommendation: add explicit id on header (id="verify-checksum") and update TOC link to /offline-install/#verify-checksum. CDN redirect currently strips fragments.

maria: I'll add the header ID and adjust the TOC link. After linkcheck turns green I'm in favor of a fast merge (squash) to ship the KB note about MTU.

samira: Security note: please include a sentence in the HSM appendix that private subnets must have egress blocked and only allow the approved KMS proxy IPs. Also add a brief suggested TCP keepalive and MSS tweak for environments with VPNs.

kevin: I'll add a one-liner in the appendix about PKCS#11 and reference the air-gapped checklist. I'll also add a CI smoke test ticket to run the conn-check sample against our staging conn-checker to catch MTU/fragmentation regressions.

maria: Perfect. Tagging this ready-for-merge pending link-bot green. If green, I'll squash+merge and push a short release note to the customer KB about the MTU caveat. Thanks all :rocket:
